blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **видна** — ви́дный: visible, conspicuous; outstanding, eminent, prominent; stately, portly. Wiktionary: вид + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **слы́шный** — audible (able to be heard). Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**слышны** — слы́шный: audible (able to be heard). Wiktionary: слы́шать + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: тру́дный — hard, difficult; зву́чный — resounding, sonorous; нау́чный — scientific; поря́дочный — decent, honest, respectable.
**наро́дный** — people's. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**у́мный** — clever, smart, intelligent. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**умен** — у́мный: clever, smart, intelligent. Wiktionary: ум + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ручно́й — (relational) hand; manual; входно́й — (relational) entrance; записно́й — (relational) note; intended for notes; резно́й — cut, carved.
**ча́стный** — private. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**ве́рный** — true, faithful, loyal. Source: Wiktionary, «-ный» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ный#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**верен** — ве́рный: true, faithful, loyal; true, right, correct. Wiktionary: ве́ра + -ный.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: отставно́й — retired; лесно́й — (relational) forest, wood; осе́нний — (relational) autumn; геро́йский — heroic.
